newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA SHARES SET RTS INDEX, VOLUME RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA SHARES SET RTS INDEX, VOLUME RECORDS.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index rose 4.9 pct on Thursday to close at a record 559.86 on a record $120.7 million total market turnover.

It was the index's third consecutive record closing, following Wednesday's 533.86. The previous record for market volume set in early July was $110 million and healthy market volume is considered $50-$60 million.
